source: You decided to pacify the Artifact.
You decided to agitate the Artifact.
[The black sludge crashes against its prison as you approach. Caged fury.]
[As if alarmed, the creature pulls back from the glass. It shifts from side to side, and finally settles at the bottom of the pod. You feel your headache subsiding.]
Well knock it off. You're supposed to help me prepare for tomorrow, not stare at the Artifact. Come on, man. I'm counting on you.
[As you lean in, the humming emanating from the pod swells. It begins to drown out your senses, and your body begins to feel tense.]

[With a slight hiss, the glass of the pod is covered in condensation. Once it settles, you spy the creature inside - now still, motionless. It reminds you of molasses, only presumably far less tasty.]
[Twisting the valve, the creature does the same - it folds over itself, solidifying. Thin, black pseudopods lash out at the glass. It's certainly agitated now.]
[You begin to perceive cracks in the humming, ranging from irregular to something oddly rhytmic. As if a language is being spoken. As if you're being spoken to.]

[You start feeling the onset of a pounding headache as your vision blurs, ever so slightly. The creature inside begins to move, slowly covering the glass window. It undulates, gently, almost beckoning you towards it.]
[The creature lies still within its container, almost indistinguishable from deep, thick oil. No movement.]

[Even after some time and after all your experiments, you still aren't used to it. To think that so much of your life is centered around this strange, ooze-like thing - something within you shudders. The discomfort is unavoidable.]

[As your fingers touch the glass, a shiver goes through your spine. The creature inside the pod solidifies against the glass behind your fingers. In your focused trance, you swear you can hear glass slowly begin to crack. It's barely perceptible, but just enough for you to catch it.]
...Eli? What's going on over there, man? What are you doing?
...What? I'm just, uh...I was just looking at it. Just for a moment.
[You catch glances of the creature inside the pod as it sways lightly to the side, as if watching you.]
[Insert a thin hose of cooling spray into the pod, pacifying it]
[Increase the pressure inside the pod, agitating it]
